rtl_result.summary: Implemented the frozen two-module accelerator with banked operand storage, fixed 8x8 MAC array, tiled control, and scalar bias/ReLU output.

files.purpose: Job control, banked storage, tile scheduling, and external interface.
Fixed 64-lane signed INT8 MAC array with wrapping INT32 accumulators.

contract_checks.requirement: Exact frozen module manifest and interfaces.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: two complete files, declared top parameters and ports, and one explicitly connected mac_tile8x8 instance.

contract_checks.requirement: Signed multiplication, wrapping accumulation and bias addition, then ReLU.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: signed 8-bit operands produce 16-bit products; additions use sign-extended intermediates and explicit low-32-bit truncation before ReLU.

contract_checks.requirement: Full-job banked buffering and sixteen simultaneous asynchronous operand reads.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: eight activation and eight weight banks have the specified depths and mappings; masked lanes receive zero without reading padding.

contract_checks.requirement: Frozen tile traversal and cycle schedule.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: loading precedes one INIT edge and K MAC edges per tile; EMIT is combinational immediately after the final MAC edge and advances local columns, rows, then tiles.

contract_checks.requirement: Ready/valid stability, completion, and invalid-command behavior.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: transfer-dependent counters advance only on handshakes; EMIT stalls preserve indices and storage; final acceptance pulses done, while rejected commands pulse error in IDLE.

contract_checks.requirement: Synchronous active-high reset without bulk storage clearing.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: reset clears control and events, suppresses external protocol outputs, inhibits storage writes, and leaves memories and accumulators uncleared.

contract_checks.requirement: Legal parameter bounds, minimum widths, and partial tiles.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: widths are clamped to at least one bit, address calculations use widened unsigned arithmetic, and terminal comparisons precede increments.

contract_checks.requirement: Synthesizable RTL with complete combinational assignments and independent register ownership.
contract_checks.evidence: Self-review: bounded loops, static arrays, explicit combinational defaults, and separate control/storage ownership; no forbidden constructs. No tools were run.

known_risks: Compilation, functional regression, and synthesis remain unverified.
